about.title: Corona Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Two people lost their lives in Corona traffic during 2025, out of 735 injury collisions reported across the city that year. Numbers that small are really names: a household on a side street off Main Street, a commuter who never made it home from SR-91 or I-15. When a death is caused by someone else's carelessness, California law allows certain relatives to bring a wrongful death claim in Riverside County civil court. A surviving spouse or domestic partner and children have the first right to file; if there are none, certain dependents and heirs may step in. The claim can recover funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. It moves on its own track, separate from any criminal charges. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Corona families with an independent attorney who takes these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Corona Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can confirm where your family stands before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and claims involving a government entity carry a much shorter window. Getting connected now protects those dates.

items.title: A full picture of recoverable losses
items.desc: Funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance are all recognized under California law. The attorney you are matched with will account for each.

items.question: The crash happened on SR-91 through Corona. Does that change who can be held responsible?
items.answer: It can. Freeway collisions sometimes involve a state agency or a public contractor in addition to another driver, and claims against a government entity in California must be presented on a far shorter timeline than the standard two years. An attorney can review the collision report and identify every party early enough to preserve those claims.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as the criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No. The criminal case is brought by the Riverside County District Attorney and focuses on punishment. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action your family brings to recover losses such as funeral costs and lost support. One can proceed whether or not the other results in charges or a conviction.

items.question: Does it cost anything to be connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and the independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency. That means there is no fee unless there is a recovery for your family.
